question: Can Visby’s putting surfaces be re-traced from orthophoto now that a GPS centre exists for every hole and two better frames are reachable?
answer: No for the OUTLINE, yes for the CENTRE. Recorded so nobody repeats it without a better image.

calibration.statistic: excess green, 2g-r-b, median across six holes
calibration.reading: Mown turf separates decisively from rough on both frames. Green from COLLAR separates only on the summer one, and only by 11 against April’s 5.5 — which is why the finer, newer frame is the worse instrument for an outline.

conclusion: The grow takes the green COMPLEX, not the putting surface: on the summer frame it reproduces every hole but at a median 1.8x the model ring’s area and a median IoU of about 0.5. That is the same failure Veckefjärden recorded at 0.27 m without a survey, restated with a survey and better imagery.

The finer April frame is WORSE, not better: it refuses seven of eighteen holes outright and scores a median IoU near 0.35. Resolution is not the binding constraint; the mow contrast is, and April flattens it.

What the tracer does reproduce is the CENTRE. Excluding holes 3 and 9, every traced centre lands within about 5 m of the model’s and 8 m of the survey’s on the summer frame. That is three records agreeing about where each green is.
So the existing rings are NOT replaced. They were traced from the 0.5 m municipal image and remain the best outline available; this run says what a re-trace would and would not buy.

hole9.reading: Both frames independently find a compact mown feature about 10 m from the survey point and about 57 m from the model ring’s centroid, and both refuse to grow anything resembling the 1670 m2 ring. That is a fifth and sixth record against the ring’s centroid. It still does not separate the two readings in green-9-review.json — a green complex and a practice green would both look like this.

hole3.reading: IoU 0.00 and a centre 236 m from the model on both frames, because the tracer is anchored on the GolfTraxx survey and GolfTraxx’s green 3 is one of the two records golftraxx-survey-review.json convicts as the provider’s error. The tracer grew a real green; it is not hole 3’s.
